meta.source: Computed by npm run build:data from data/safety.json (settings compared), data/troubleshooting.json (shower temperature, inlet example), data/fixture-flow-rates.json and data/site.json with assets/js/formulas.js
meta.notes: Tank share of a mixed shower = (shower − inlet) ÷ (tank − inlet), formulas.hotShareOfMix; tank gallons = flow × minutes × share, formulas.hotGallonsDrawn; extra mixed water = share at 120 °F ÷ share at the hotter setting − 1, formulas.extraMixedWaterShare. Only true when a mixing valve (or the user) mixes the water down to the same shower temperature. Heat loss in the pipes and in the tank is not counted, so real tanks deliver a little less in every row.

columns.label: Share of the shower from the tank

capacity.source: Computed with the size calculator’s hot-share formula (see Methodology); shower temperature from Stiebel Eltron's sizing sheet, winter inlet from A. O. Smith, shower flow is the federal maximum. Needs a mixing valve to hold the shower at the same temperature.
